title: Endpoint classification rule pack
description: A versioned set of deterministic rules mapping registry outcome-measure text onto canonical endpoint concepts. Rule packs are the only place classification logic lives, so every assignment is reproducible and attributable.

priority.description: Higher wins when several rules match. Specific rules should outrank general ones.

confidence.description: Author's stated confidence that a match implies the concept.

therapeutic_area_hint.description: Only apply when the study's conditions map to this TA. Disambiguates homographs such as 'response'.

match.description: All present clauses must hold for the rule to fire.

any_of.description: Case-insensitive regexes; at least one must match.

fields.description: Which source fields the regexes are applied to.

asserts.description: Structure this rule can assert directly, overriding concept defaults where a surface form is more specific than the concept.
